name: sitemirror
description: SiteMirror — crawl any website into an offline-browsable ZIP. Run both the backend and frontend from the repo root.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
